seo.title: Products | POS, QR Menu & Business Software | Setu
seo.description: Explore Setu's products — the free Browser Based POS and QR Menu, plus Setu Dine and Setu Queue for restaurants, with Setu Retail and Setu Clinic coming soon.

hero.headline: One company, building for every industry
hero.subheadline: We started with restaurants. Here's what's live today, and what's coming next.

products.name: Browser Based POS
products.headline: Free offline POS, right in your browser
products.description: A completely free point-of-sale for small businesses. Bill customers, manage products and inventory, hold and recall carts, and print thermal receipts — no login, no subscription, and it keeps working without internet. All data stays on your device, with one-click backup and restore.
features: Fast billing with barcode scanner support

cta.label: Open Browser Based POS — it's free

products.name: Setu QR Menu
products.headline: A QR code that never needs reprinting
products.description: Your menu lives online and the printed QR code holds only a short permanent link. Change a price, mark a dish sold out or swap in a seasonal menu — the code on your tables keeps working. Dish photos, sizes and variations, multiple menus and daily scan counts — free for your first year.
features: One permanent QR code, printed once
Multiple menus you can switch between

products.name: Setu Dine
products.headline: Restaurant management, done right
products.description: Billing, kitchen workflow, table management, multi-outlet dashboards, customer management, coupons and a built-in tax engine — everything a restaurant needs to run smoothly, from a single outlet to a full chain.

products.name: Setu Queue
products.headline: QSR counter service, sorted
products.description: Counter billing, token management, kitchen routing and customer pickup display — built for quick service restaurants and food courts.

products.name: Setu Retail
products.headline: Retail store management, coming soon
products.description: Inventory tracking, billing and store operations built for retail businesses across the globe.

products.name: Setu for your business
products.headline: Building for your industry next
products.description: If you don't see your industry yet, tell us what you run. We're building Setu for every kind of business, one industry at a time.
